canonical_target_semantics.finish_position: Official classified position (FastF1 Position), verbatim via frozen v2/d9.py labels_from_results. Equals classified_position whenever both non-null (verified identical in 2018-2024 corpus). Null only for never-started withdrawals (3 rows, 0 laps).
canonical_target_semantics.points_equivalence: P(top-10) and P(points) are the same event per-row in 2018-2024 (scored_points defined as points > 0). Contract admits P_top10 only; a separate P_points output would duplicate it, not extend it.

threshold_labels.P_top10: position_final <= 10 (exactly 10/race; identical event to points>0 in 2018-2024)

canonical_target_semantics.unclassified_back_rank: Unclassified retirees/DNS/DSQ carry source tail orderings (observed range 13-20, never <=10 in 2018-2024). These are NOT earned slots and must never train ordinal/exact-position models as if they were.

censoring_policy.ordinal_supervision: classified_flag true only (deferred with formulation B)
censoring_policy.prediction_time: eligibility from state existence at T only; labels never consulted
censoring_policy.threshold_supervision: all rows with non-null position_final included (unclassified are structural >10 negatives); 3 null-final rows excluded

coherence_policy.alternatives: formulation-disallowed incoherence OR rejection-on-violation; chosen: projection, documented mathematically in V3.5B dataset contract
coherence_policy.field_coherence: whole-field exclusivity (exactly one P1, etc.) is NOT claimed; per-driver marginals only
coherence_policy.mechanism: deterministic monotonic projection (non-decreasing rearrangement across the 4 thresholds) frozen as part of the method BEFORE any screening
coherence_policy.rule: p_win <= p_podium <= p_top5 <= p_top10 for every predicted row

compute_budget.grids: small and predeclared; no unconstrained search
compute_budget.per_candidate_family: minutes to low tens of minutes on M4 MacBook Air

feature_policy.future_feature_need: documented as explicit experiment, never silent addition

field_size_policy.corpus_fact: 20 drivers except 2024-r03-R (19); thresholds are field-size-free so no fixed-20 assumption is needed
field_size_policy.fixed_20_multiclass: NOT scientifically exact for this corpus (deferred with formulation C)

B_ordinal.reason: no ordinal implementation in frozen deps; proportional-odds assumptions untested; threshold selection captures most value first

C_multiclass_exact_position.reason: 20-class with tail back-rank contamination, per-driver race-exclusivity unenforceable, heavier; revisit only if thresholds prove insufficient

D_regression_distributional.reason: bounded discrete target vs continuous loss mismatch; uncertainty estimation ad-hoc; calibration path unclear

E_pairwise_ranking.reason: 190 pairs/state x 162k states compute; conversion to calibrated finish distributions nontrivial; head-to-head outputs deferred with it

F_survival_competing_risk.reason: retirement structure already handled by classification flags; competing-risk machinery disproportionate to the question

G_discovered.verdict: NONE (no superior formulation found in audit)

p_win comparability with V3.1B is diagnostic, not identity
2025 globally non-pristine; V3.5F disclosure must stay conservative

output_contract.coherence: p_win <= p_podium <= p_top5 <= p_top10 enforced by frozen projection; violations rejected, never silently shipped
deferred: head-to-head (require exact-position or pairwise machinery; not admitted until a later contract)

p_podium.meaning: P(finish position <= 3 | state T), RAW independent-binary

p_top10.meaning: P(finish position <= 10 | state T), RAW independent-binary; in-corpus identical event to scoring points

p_top5.meaning: P(finish position <= 5 | state T), RAW independent-binary

p_win.meaning: P(finish position == 1 | state T), RAW independent-binary, not field-normalized

prediction_population: All starters with an observable state at time T (state existence at T only). DNS/never-started drivers are excluded by construction (no lap states exist), never by label filtering: no future leakage. Drivers who later retire are INCLUDED (excluding them would leak future information).
primary_metric_definition: Race-macro binary log loss (frozen eps 1e-15) per threshold, then unweighted mean over the 4 cumulative tasks. Proper scoring rule; matches V3.1B lineage; race-macro keeps large-state races from dominating.
primary_task_definition: Four binary cumulative tasks on the same state rows: P(finish<=1), P(finish<=3), P(finish<=5), P(finish<=10). One shared frozen method with a deterministic monotonicity projection (see coherence_policy).
relation_to_mc2: V3.5 learns conditional per-driver outcome marginals; MC2 simulates mutually exclusive joint futures (FinishOrder: unique 1..K + explicit retirees). Do not fuse. V3.8 owns model x simulation consensus.
relation_to_v3_1b: V3.5 does not replace V3.1B. V3.1B P(win) is RAW INDEPENDENT_BINARY and stays the standalone champion reference. V3.5 p_win must be compared against V3.1B on the same race-macro LL; agreement is not required (different feature/selection context may follow), but any large divergence must be explained, not reinterpreted. No serving change.
scientific_question: Can the platform estimate useful probability distributions over driver race outcomes from a historical race state at time T while preserving strict temporal causality, coherent probability semantics, and honest uncertainty?
secondary_tasks: exact position distribution via threshold-differencing (diagnostic only; coherence caveats documented, not a promotion path)

stage_plan.V3.5B: Dataset + Target Construction (threshold label frame + population + monotonic projection spec)
stage_plan.V3.5D: Candidate Model Screening (closed-set screen on D1/D2/D3)
stage_plan.V3.5E: Controlled Refinement / Calibration (if D warrants; RAW default)

status_policy.DNS_never_started: no states, no supervised rows; excluded by construction
status_policy.DSQ: unclassified back-rank; threshold-negative only; excluded from ordinal supervision
status_policy.classified_finishers: full outcome labels; eligible for all tasks
status_policy.classified_retirements: classified (90% rule) incl. lapped classified; eligible for all tasks
status_policy.eligibility_rule: ordinal/exact-position supervision conditions on classified_flag (frozen F14 helper); never on non-null final_position alone
status_policy.null_final_withdrawals: 3 rows, 0 laps; no states, no supervised rows
status_policy.unclassified_retirements: valid negatives for cumulative thresholds (position > 10 structurally); EXCLUDED from ordinal/exact-position supervision
